findings.reason: the plan must state the observed-session delivery is keyed on the session alone, not on the start kind, or a node replaying `_is_own_start` sends the fix at the wrong gate and the observed-session negative control never goes green.
findings.text: the deliverable says RowPolicy "delivers an observed session's rows as it delivers the own session's starts", but the own-session delivery it is modelled on, `_is_own_start` (reckon/crew/ticker.py:1313), gates on `kind == START_KIND` (ticker.py:1325); the observed-session rows the done-when names are observer-context transitions such as the `working` rows fed at tests/test_follow_observes_other_sessions.py:322 and :418 (phase="working", kind `(None,"working")`), which the observer-context hold at ticker.py:1605-1616 withholds because they are neither coordinator nor start kinds, so an implementation that mirrors the own-start exemption (session check plus START_KIND) leaves those five ids red and the done-when ("the thirteen ids pass alone") unmet

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — commit 089cd7741, the follower-family report path, RowPolicy.feed, follower_row_path, SETTLE_WINDOW and every named test file resolve; the extensionless href /reckon/plans/the-suite-is-green-at-head resolves as .html.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when is measurable (thirteen ids pass alone; the two pins still pass; importers show no added failure) and it declares a negative control that can fail: dropping the observed-session delivery must red the observed-session cases.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate is logged under the run directory (durable) and the cited investigation report sits on a durable reports path, not a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the mechanism is named by what it does (deliver an observed session's rows, keep the hold); no plan labels, ticket numbers or changelog prose reach the deliverable.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the deliverable's mechanism, read as an extension of the own-start exemption, is start-kind-gated and so cannot deliver the observed session's non-start rows the done-when names.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable: make the follower family green while keeping the observer-context and settle holds, split into a product change and test re-anchors of the same behaviour.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §15 declares no depends-on/informs/gates and needs none: its only external input is the follower-family investigation it cites, which is already produced, and its write paths do not overlap a held or in-flight section (§6's routier hold does not touch ticker.py or the follower tests).
